So there's no GPIO or other communication path to figure out state? I worry a bit that after a BMC reset the state will just always be Unknown.
I think it's getting time to move the source files under sub-dirs. Like one for host, chassis, bmc, and now drive. But we can do that after we get this in.
Why is this needed? I know we have it one service that's responsible for APR function (need to run after system has reached BMC Ready) but does this service have a similar requirement?
